entity.description:
Brudiclad is a Myr-like compleated artifact creature who is able to meld flesh and metal in glorious harmony.

During the Time Spiral crisis he was transported through a time rift from a possible future to Dominaria.

That future came to pass when, during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse, he fought on the side of the invaders.
